doc: Event script for the train in the Forest Tunnel (s03). Flotsam's gang chases the train in a buggy and Max, with Cedric, throws bombs at it in the buggy subgame (story 204). If the train is lost the player can retry (story 205). When the boss blows himself up Monica rescues them (story 206) and the train heads on to Sindain Station (s02).
